metadata.name: mochi_game
metadata.description: Mochi Moon on-chain game (stage 5): real engine, zero-copy state, phase guards, batching, compressed ghosts

instructions.name: act
docs: One player action (shop, last chance, mark, concede), phase-guarded.

instructions.name: act_batch
docs: Up to MAX_BATCH actions (3 bytes each: code, a, b), applied in order, each validated against the state left
by the previous one. All-or-nothing: the state is changed on a copy and written back only if all pass.

instructions.name: begin_run
docs: Roll the run seed (fallback randomness: hash of the secret salt + slot) and offer the hero choices.

instructions.name: claim_reward
docs: Claim a season reward on Solana with the proof the TEE gave the player (any time after the root is
published; one-shot per player per season).

accounts.name: ranking
docs: program-owned again = the published copy on Solana

instructions.name: clear_pool
docs: Delete every ghost of the season, then commit + undelegate the empty shard.

instructions.name: close_season
docs: Freeze the ranking and build the Merkle root of (rank, player, reward).

instructions.name: fight
docs: Fight today's opponent (pool ghost, else bot template). Records the fight for the client's replay and
archives the ghost + updates the ranking when the fight ends the run.

instructions.name: finalize_player
docs: Player's season end: a run still going is cancelled (no ghost, no score), secrets are scrubbed BEFORE the
commit (the committed copy is public), then commit + undelegate.

instructions.name: finish_run
docs: After a concede: archive the run's ghost (final build included) and update the ranking.

instructions.name: init_player
docs: Create the player's season account on Solana (before delegation: no secrets yet). The pool seat is taken
later on the TEE (`join_pool`), because the pool shard is delegated there.

instructions.name: issue_proof
docs: Give one ranked player their (rank, reward, proof), in their own private account.

instructions.name: join_pool
docs: Take a seat in the player's pool shard (on the TEE, where the shard lives). Owner or session key.

instructions.name: pick_hero
docs: Pick one of the offered heroes; the run starts (run.ts newRun).

instructions.name: player_permission
docs: Player is private to its owner and the current session key (create, or update after a new session).

instructions.name: publish_root
docs: After every ranked player got their proof: scrub the ranking, publish only the root.

instructions.name: revoke_session
docs: Owner revokes the session key immediately.

instructions.name: set_salt
docs: Secret salt, written only after delegation (the account is private by then).

instructions.name: set_season_end
docs: Admin: move the season end (only while the season is running, never into the past).

instructions.name: set_session
docs: Owner approves a session key (the browser's) until `expiry` (at most MAX_SESSION from now).

errors.name: BadPhase
errors.msg: action not allowed in this phase

errors.name: Rejected
errors.msg: action rejected by the game rules

errors.name: SimVersion
errors.msg: account was written by another sim version

types.name: Player
docs: One per player per season. Zero-copy; `run` is a mochi_engine RunState, `prev` / `last_opp` are Builds.

fields.name: last_opp
docs: the last fight (client replay): opponent build, day, result (1 draw, 2 won, 3 lost), opponent kind

fields.name: session_expiry
docs: session key the owner approved (wallet signs once); valid while now < session_expiry (unix ts)

types.name: Ranking
docs: Season ranking (Arena content): private on the TEE; after the season only `root` is published.

types.name: Wallet
docs: In-game currency credited by claims (on Solana for now; requirement C6 is still open).
